objects: one resolving spell or ability source
events: ordinary canonical damage result and trigger events
state_reads: current damage replacement and prevention effects
state_writes: ordinary state-based actions after the complete instruction
timing: target legality and creature status are rechecked at resolution
both damage events are prepared before either result is committed
targets: one or two represented battlefield creature targets
a source or enchanted creature may occupy one Fight role
apnap: resulting triggers use ordinary APNAP batching
layers: current layer-derived type and exact power are read at resolution
replacement_effects: both proposals enter the canonical damage replacement and prevention transaction
copy: copied and text-changed Fight instructions remain outside this compiler slice
control_change: current controller-relative targeting is revalidated independently of the damage source snapshot
zone_change: Fight does nothing if either creature has left or is no longer a creature
a new incarnation cannot satisfy the old source reference
source_leaves: unlike one-way creature-power damage, Fight does not use source last-known information when a participant is absent

variants: self-Fight deals twice its power to itself

implementation.component: quorune.compiler.creature_power_damage_templates, quorune.rules.creature_power_damage_capability_shapes, quorune.creature_power_damage, and the canonical damage transaction
implementation.supported_slice: Closed Fight and one-way exact creature-power damage with one or two public targets and fixed Fight preparation.

known_blockers: external-event and reflexive linked objects need their typed event owners
random, mass, divided, multiplied, toughness-based, and open dynamic quantities remain residual
unrepresentable characteristic-defining, cyclic, copy, face-down, and type-changing interactions remain excluded
